WorkItem.Description:
The file FSharp.Core.dll provided in the SscBoogie/Binaries directory is version 1.9.6.16 but the one included with Boogie (in the Binaries directory) is 2.0.0.0

This means that compiling everything from source fails when you get to SscBoogie (with complaints about FSharp.Core.dll). It might be better if the Makefile in SscBoogie/Binaries copied the FSharp dlls across from Boogie, along with everything it currently grabs, to make sure the versions are consistent.
WorkItem.Summary: F# binaries included with SSCBoogie not compatible with those included with Boogie
